kjv: they (the crowds) called Barnabas, Jupiter; and Paul, Mercurius
mine: Barnabas they (the crowds) called Zeus, and Paul, Hermes
note: The Greek names Zeus and Hermes are rendered by their Latin equivalents, a convention of 1611; the local legend of Zeus and Hermes visiting Phrygia (Ovid's Baucis and Philemon) explains the crowd's reaction.
